title: QUIZ - 59
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a system of equations by adding equations with opposite coefficients
questions.question: Solve the system using elimination: \( 2y + 6m = -26 \) and \( -2y + 3m = -37 \). What is m?
questions.explanation: Adding the two equations eliminates y: (6+3)m = -63, so m = -7.
questions.hint: Add the two equations directly; since the x-terms are opposites, they will cancel out.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the scaling factor needed to eliminate a variable using the elimination method
questions.question: To eliminate n from the system \( 5n + 6a = 22 \) and \( 1n + 4a = 10 \), by what factor should the first equation be multiplied (before subtracting)?
questions.explanation: Multiplying the first equation by 1 makes its n-coefficient 5, matching \(1 \times 5\) in a way that lets n be eliminated by subtraction with the second equation scaled by 5.
questions.hint: Multiply one or both equations so that the coefficients of the variable to be eliminated become equal in magnitude.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a general system of two equations using the elimination method
questions.question: Solve the system using elimination: \( 3y + 4m = -15 \) and \( 2y + 5m = -24 \). What is y?
